description: `#orbitshowcase` — a scroll-driven per-character opacity reveal over two arc SVGs and a Rive scene, on an oklch gradient (G1). The one section whose motion has a published reduced-motion fallback in the real source.

lede.note: revealed character by character; split into words grouped in non-wrapping spans

provenance.note: Provenance of this asset in the page being specified. `generated` is FORBIDDEN for any assetRole whose generationPolicy is must-not-fabricate-real-brand or must-not-fabricate-compliance-claim, and for must-reuse-exact roles. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#ASSET_PROVENANCE_POLICY and schema/semantic_validate.py.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio for the wrapper box (e.g. "799/617"). Used by Rive assets, which have no intrinsic pixel size, INSTEAD of intrinsicWidth/Height.

motion.linearity: LINEAR in scroll, not eased — constant chars/px across 16+ samples per viewport height.
motion.spanFormula: 0.34425 * vh + 87.9px (AFFINE in vh, not a fixed px length and not a fixed fraction of vh)
motion.spanEvidence: measured slopes 0.5782 / 0.4771 / 0.4075 chars-per-px at vh 700 / 900 / 1100; span/vh drifts monotonically (0.4694 / 0.4425 / 0.4239) which rules out a vh-proportional window; span grows 69.6px then 68.1px per 200px of vh, so growth is constant. Least-squares over the three heights gives sub-pixel residuals (-0.3 / +0.5 / -0.3 px).

spring.evidence: after an instant jump-scroll the lit count keeps climbing ~1.2s with no overshoot; residual decays with tau ~= 215ms. stiffness 120 / damping 30 has a dominant pole of 4.75 rad/s -> tau 210ms.

motion.notes: This affine span CANNOT be expressed as a framer `useScroll` offset pair (both offset forms are purely vh-relative); progress is driven from a measured container-top -> progress mapping re-read from the live rect each scroll frame. Do not remove the spring: without it the reveal snaps.
